content:
{
  "phoneNote": "The aquatic palette feels appropriate, but the oversized three-line headline dominates the opening screen and pushes the schedule card into an awkward transition below it.",
  "desktopNote": "The pool imagery and yellow accents work well, but the large empty band above the oversized hero headline delays the useful information.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Reduce the hero headline size, especially on phones, and shorten the desktop gap beneath the navigation so the introduction, action and schedule form one compact composition.",
    "Integrate the floating schedule card into the practical-information strip and reduce repeated time, location and contact details across the steps, FAQ and contact section.",
    "Use a shorter landscape crop for the phone’s pool-ladder image so the teaching approach appears sooner rather than following a tall standalone image."
  ]
}
